rules: Source PNGs must be isolated; pack ONLY after inspection and exact pixel placement.
No generated art grid is a verified texture atlas.
Do not bake independent frame, fill, thumb, glow or button state into a single part.
No automatic pointer hit-testing is promised by the manifest; game/web host supplies pointer events.
Generate search/navigation as projections from authored manifests only.
